spanish: Y en el día el octavo tomará a ella dos tórtolas o dos hijos de paloma, y los traerá al sacerdote, a abertura de tienda de reunión.

findings.issue: לָהּ is preposition ל plus a 3fs suffix (for/to her), not the object of תִּקַּח. “tomará a ella” makes her the person taken; the things taken are the birds.

notes: The rest of the verse matches the tokens, including both bird options, 3fs bring, them, the priest, and opening of tent of meeting.
